answer: Created migration 007 and seeded multi-branch architecture (Gulberg Main & DHA Phase 5); added transactional inter-branch stock transfers with FIFO receipt lots; implemented Head Office consolidated dashboard with branch matrix comparison; added registered multi-device terminal management; enhanced KDS with Web Audio chime, preparation elapsed timers, and delayed order warnings; added POS special cooking notes, table transfers, and offline order queueing with auto-sync.

question: Implement inward purchases management, menu recipes with dynamic profit margin calculations, and error-free KDS status filters

question: Streamline Workspace Hub to 3 core terminals, implement menu sub-categories, and add interactive product addons/modifiers across POS and KDS
answer: Focused WorkspaceHub (/hub) to display only Dashboard, POS Terminal, and Kitchen Terminal in a balanced 3-column layout; added parent-child category hierarchy with sub-category tabs in Menu Catalog and fast category/subcategory filter pills on POS Terminal; implemented Addon / Modifier Groups with options and pricing (extra sauces, dips, cheeses, upgrades) in Menu Catalog; created interactive POS Customize Order Item / Addons modal with portion size selection, multi-select checkboxes, special cooking instruction chips, and live pricing; updated POS Cart to show addons and notes per item; updated order submission to persist modifiers and pass to KOTs; and enhanced Kitchen Display System to prominently render addons badges and cooking notes for kitchen staff.

question: Implement multiple bill printing options and templates (Standard 80mm, Fine Dining Guest Check, Compact 58mm, GST A4 Invoice, Kitchen Token)
answer: Implemented 5 distinct bill printing templates in ReceiptModal.tsx: Standard 80mm POS thermal receipt, Fine Dining Guest Check with tip guide and signature line, Compact 58mm mobile/kiosk slip, Official Commercial GST Tax Invoice in full A4 format, and Kitchen Order / Pickup Token. question: Verify multi-device synchronization (Waiter Tablet -> Kitchen Display System -> Cashier Register) and end-to-end CRUD functionality
answer: Created comprehensive integration test suite backend/test/multidevice_and_full_crud.test.ts covering multi-device real-time flow: Waiter places Dine-In order with product variant, addons, and cooking instructions; KDS receives ticket with modifiers summary and advances status through PENDING -> ACCEPTED -> PREPARING -> READY -> SERVED with ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED sync event; Cashier sees served order in unpaid active drawer, settles payment via cash with change, deducts exact FIFO batch stock, releases table back to AVAILABLE, and prints multi-template receipt. Verified full CRUD operations across categories, sub-categories, addon groups, inward purchases, suppliers, and recipes. All 41 monorepo tests pass.

question: How was the menu product creation and costing section optimized to allow direct cost input and live margin calculations?

question: How was staff & employee management enhanced to support editing employee details, login username/email, resetting passwords, and status toggles?

question: How do we bridge the real-time gap between KDS served tickets and dashboard financial reporting?
answer: commit 30c075f: Added 5-second auto-polling to RestaurantDashboard with live status badge and manual refresh, updated financial summary routes to aggregate served unpaid orders and in-flight amounts, and rendered a dedicated Live Operations & Unpaid Bills widget with direct POS settlement shortcuts.

question: Why did the dashboard show Rs. 0 and no sales even when orders were placed and served?
answer: commit 2fd06aa: Diagnosed three causes: 1) The active branch selector in the session was set to DHA Phase 5 Branch (0 orders) while all sales occurred in Gulberg Main Branch; 2) POS terminal previously hardcoded user.branchId instead of honoring currentBranchId; 3) Dashboard date boundaries used UTC string splitting instead of local date boundaries. Fixed POS branch inheritance, timezone calculation, added in-dashboard branch switcher, and multi-branch sales guidance banner.

question: How was the custom date selector implemented in Orders Hub to filter orders of a specific date?
answer: Added a dedicated Specific Date Calendar selector and Custom Date Range picker to OrdersHub All Orders History tab, featuring prev/next day steppers, jump-to-today shortcut, human-friendly date header, multi-branch dropdown filter, and backend period financial summary strip (total orders, total revenue, completed sales, and cancelled/refunded counts) calculated in GET /api/orders.

question: How was the POS terminal optimized with vertical categories, subcategories, editable delivery pricing, customer details, and adjustable billing width?
answer: Restructured PosTerminal.tsx into an ergonomic 3-column layout: 1) Vertical Categories & Subcategories Sidebar with item counters and accordion subcategory navigation; 2) Menu Items section with Vertical List view and Grid toggle, search, and variants; 3) Resizable Billing/Cart Section with draggable edge handle (320px-800px) and width presets (S, M, L, XL, toggle); and 4) Delivery Order panel with Customer Name, Mobile Number, Delivery Address, and editable Delivery Fee/Price with quick presets.

question: Remove Counter order type, add customer details to Takeaway, and add customer and rider details to Delivery in POS Terminal

Added customer information, address, editable delivery fee, and rider name and phone fields for Delivery. question: Conduct comprehensive restaurant owner QA and QC audit across software and fix Daybook net sales and delivery fee calculations

question: Why was the dashboard not updating when making orders and how was instant reactivity achieved (dc3f2f6)?
answer: Diagnosed critical syntax error in RestaurantDashboard.tsx where /orders/active was queried as /orders/active&branchId=... without '?', triggering Fastify route matching on /api/orders/:id with invalid UUID and throwing Postgres 500. This caused Promise.all to reject silently and prevented all metrics, top products, recent orders, and active orders from updating. Fixed API query syntax to /orders/active?branchId=..., added defensive UUID regex validation in GET /api/orders/:id, repaired top product field mappings (product_name and total_quantity), expanded Live Operations banner to display all in-flight orders (kitchen cooking + served unpaid), reduced polling interval to 3s, and added instant window event ('pos_order_updated') and storage triggers across PosTerminal, OrdersHub, and KitchenDisplay in commit dc3f2f6.
